newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-OLS says Fletcher Asia talks continue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-OLS says Fletcher Asia talks continue.

text.p: OLS Asia Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that it was in negotiations with Fletcher Challenge Ltd about the acquisition of the New Zealand-based company's construction assets in Asia.
OLS had said earlier that it had acquired the assets, including a public construction licence in Hong Kong and Fletcher Challenge Construction subsidiaries in Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia.
Fletcher Challenge responded later in the day that a deal had not been struck and that negotiations were continuing.
OLS managing director Alfred Siu said the company had issued its initial statement to keep shareholders properly informed and avoid speculation within the local property sector.

"Mr Sui said that while it appeared cultural differences between the parties may have led to a misinterpretation of where levels of agreement stood on the proposed acquisition, he agreed with Fletcher Challenge that negotiations were underway and that formal documentation, as stated in OLS's announcement earlier today, had still to be drawn up and agreed to," the latest OLS statement said.
